Both critical radii are <2, so no extrapolation beyond interval. Signed-permutation uniqueness forces optimal ellipsoids balls; exact contact sets follow from strict equality. Finite rational spot checks only supplement analytic inequalities.

final_claim: For the facet-defined log-cosh Orlicz body of the unit regular three-dimensional octahedron at level 1, the John ball radius is 2 arcosh(e^(1/4)) contacting exactly axes, the Loewner ball radius is unique solution log cosh(sqrt(3)r/2)+3log cosh(r/(2sqrt(3)))=1 contacting exactly eight diagonals; sharp radial inequalities for r∈[0,2].
